children: Global Interactive Technologies, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results showing minimal revenue but a wider net loss versus the prior-year quarter as the company continues early commercialization of its Faning platform.
Revenue: $0.13K for Q2 2026, up from $0.03K in Q2 2025 (three-months: $126 vs $29; ~335% YoY).
Net income: Net loss of $(908.4K) for Q2 2026, versus net loss of $(678.0K) in Q2 2025 (worsened YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(0.25) for Q2 2026, versus $(0.22) in Q2 2025 (loss per share widened YoY).
Revenue growth and commercialization: Revenue remained minimal but rose modestly in H1 2026 versus 2025 as Faning moved from relaunch toward early commercialization.
Platform focus and product evolution: Continued development and maintenance of Faning 2.0 with community features, multilingual support and monetization tools.
User base opportunity: Legacy Fantoo’s approximately 26.6 million registered accounts represent a strategic long-term asset; migration or reactivation efforts have not yet been executed.
Monetization & KPIs: Early-stage monetization through subscriptions, in-app purchases and advertising; KPIs tracked include MAUs, ARPU and UAC, with monetization timing delayed about 12 months.
Operational and financing actions: Completed a June 2026 private placement to fund commercialization, repaid certain short-term obligations, and pursued compliance and restructuring efforts.
